name: pyros3d
description: Windows dependency set for Pyros3D (MSVC). Ignored unless you configure with vcpkg's toolchain file, so macOS/Linux Homebrew and apt builds are unaffected.
$comment-lua: Pinned to 5.4.x deliberately: the current lua port is 5.5, which the vendored sol.hpp does not support and which PyrosDependencies.cmake rejects (it accepts LUA_VERSION_NUM 501-504 only).
$comment-baseline: Baseline is deliberately a few weeks behind master so the commit is already present in CI images' vcpkg clones and does not have to be fetched.
